'''Shuror''' was a [[City/Legends|town]] located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Prior to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]-spanning conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Kal Skirata]] and his wife, [[Ilippi Skirata]], shared a small townhouse in Shuror early in their [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]]. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], long after their marriage had come to an end, Kal Skirata found himself reminiscing on his [[Time/Legends|time]] in Shuror with Ilippi while cutting [[Tree/Legends|wood]] at his new [[Vheh'yaim/Legends|home]] of [[Kyrimorut/Legends|Kyrimorut]].<ref name="ImpCom" />

==Behind the scenes==
The town of Shuror was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2009]] novel, ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', the fifth entry into the [[Republic Commando|''Republic'' and ''Imperial Commando'']] novel series by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]].
